_comment: Columns match public.properties in supabase/migrations/20250315000000_enable_pgvector_properties.sql. id is a stable uuid so the seed can upsert. embedding is not stored here; the seed script generates it. Copy matches docs/sample-properties.md. The word cabin is absent on purpose.

properties.title: Stillwater cottage
properties.description: A two-bedroom cottage sits on a still lake. Most summer weekends are booked by guests, and those nightly stays have covered the mortgage for three seasons.

properties.title: Pine bench cottage
properties.description: A small cottage stands in a dry pine grove. The road ends at the property, neighbors are distant, and nights pass with little traffic.

properties.title: Maple cul-de-sac house
properties.description: A three-bedroom house sits on a dead-end street. An elementary campus is two blocks away, the yard is fenced, and a playground sits at the corner.

properties.title: Baker street flat
properties.description: A one-bedroom flat sits above a corner bakery in the city center. Cafes and dinner spots line the same block, and residents walk to work.

properties.title: Lantern row duplex
properties.description: A side-by-side duplex holds two occupied units. Both households have renewed for another year, and the combined monthly payments cover the loan with money left over.

properties.title: Neon alley loft
properties.description: A studio loft sits above a downtown nightclub. Music runs past midnight, crowds fill the sidewalk, and the street stays loud until the bars close.

properties.title: Harbor office loft
properties.description: A commercial loft stands beside a working harbor. Weekday tenants run a small shipping desk. The space is loud at dawn when boats load.

properties.title: Hay acreage
properties.description: Open acreage is used for hay and cattle. There is no house on the parcel. Access is a county road.
